{{Color box|{{party color|One Cebu}}|border=darkgray}} [[One Cebu|1CEBU]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Cebu's 7th congressional district''' is one of the seven [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Cebu]]. It was represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] from 1916 to 1972, and again since [[2016 Philippine House of Representatives elections|2016]]. It was also earlier represented in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 30, 2020 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the southwestern municipalities of [[Alcantara, Cebu|Alcantara]], [[Alegria, Cebu|Alegria]], [[Badian, Cebu|Badian]], [[Dumanjug]], [[Ginatilan]], [[Malabuyoc]], [[Moalboal]] and [[Ronda, Cebu|Ronda]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Patricia Calderon]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC) and [[One Cebu]] (1CEBU).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 30, 2020}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, the district encompassed the northwestern Cebu municipalities of [[Asturias, Cebu|Asturias]], [[Balamban]], [[Bantayan, Cebu|Bantayan]], [[Daanbantayan]], [[Madridejos, Cebu|Madridejos]], [[Medellin, Cebu|Medellin]], [[San Remigio, Cebu|San Remigio]], [[Santa Fe, Cebu|Santa Fe]], [[Tabuelan]], and [[Tuburan, Cebu|Tuburan]]. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
